findings.title: PDF block tokens replaced before marked; inline SVG/HTML with blank lines + indentation becomes escaped <pre><code> (verified with marked 15.0.2), post-check doesn't catch it
findings.fix:
Two-phase replacement: inline config tokens before marked (escaped), block tokens (ARCHITECTURE_SVG, SAMPLE_GUIDES, LINK_CHECK_TABLE, SCREENSHOTS) after marked by replacing

{{KEY}}

; fail on unreplaced tokens, escaped <svg/<table/<figure, or missing in sec-03.

findings.title: normalizeDraft leaves empty optional strings (zod Str().optional() rejects "" — verified) and never normalizes verifier output; confidence note source and uncertain-cap ordering unspecified
findings.fix: Rule 1: null or empty-after-trim optional -> undefined; add normalizeVerification (trim, drop empty array items, empty note -> undefined); note = verifier note when verifier lowered the level else draft note; prepend pipeline notes before slicing uncertain to 15; add tests.

findings.title: Repair-retry flow contradictory between Stage 4 (validate after draft) and Stage 6 (fail after verify -> re-draft); re-verify and step events unspecified; DraftInvalid both module-private and caught by instanceof in pipeline
findings.fix: Validate via assembleGuide(verification:null) probe right after each draft attempt, repair at most once, re-send step draft active with detail; verify exactly once; final assemble failure -> LLM_FAILED without retry; export DraftInvalid.

findings.title: README '&&' commands fail in Windows PowerShell 5.1 (user's shell)
findings.fix: Use npm --prefix backend install / npm --prefix backend run dev, one per line.

findings.title: /\bloom\b/i check scans base64 screenshot data and can false-positive
findings.fix: Strip data:image base64 URIs before the check.

findings.title: streamGenerate has no headers timeout
findings.fix: headersTimeoutMs = 90000 -> ApiError NETWORK; clear on first byte; user cancel stays 'cancelled'.

findings.title: Client handling after terminal events unspecified
findings.fix: Ignore events after first error; guide received + no done = complete, not STREAM_INTERRUPTED.

findings.title: GuideDetail API response and store listRecent output not validated
findings.fix: safeParse GET /api/guides/:slug on client (BAD_RESPONSE); filter recent with a GuideSummarySchema server-side.

findings.title: STORE=upstash without creds and PipelineDeps when keys missing unspecified
findings.fix: Fatal at boot; build stub deps throwing CONFIG_MISSING.

findings.title: URL-rule failure messages missing in input rule 4
findings.fix: Single message: 'Enter a public app name or developer docs URL (max 200 characters).'

findings.title: Local screenshot capture builds without VITE_API_URL so Generate form is disabled
findings.fix: Document $env:VITE_API_URL='http://localhost:8787' before frontend build, or use deployed BASE_URL.

findings.title: Cache-hit step label unspecified; hourly limit hint hardcodes 5
findings.fix: Label 'Found a guide generated {relative time}'; expose rateLimitMax in /api/health and render it.

findings.title: frontend vitest.config.ts omits React plugin
findings.fix: defineConfig({ plugins: [react()], test: { environment: 'jsdom', globals: true, setupFiles: ['src/test/setup.ts'] } }).

findings.title: Aliases miss common phrasings (e.g. 'Microsoft Entra ID', 'Atlassian Jira') causing paid live runs for curated apps
findings.fix: Authoring rule to include normalized keys of common phrasings; curated.test asserts match for a list of phrasings.
